defect.reproducer: Run ros2 run patrol patrol with turtlesim in domain 16: /cmd_vel has one publisher and zero subscribers; /turtle1/cmd_vel has zero publishers and one subscriber. Pose is received but turtle remains at x=5.544445 y=5.544445 theta=0.
defect.root_cause: Relative cmd_vel resolves to /cmd_vel in the root namespace. Turtlesim listens on /turtle1/cmd_vel. Matching Twist type and ROS domain do not connect different topic names.
defect.proof_after: Restart only patrol with --ros-args -r cmd_vel:=/turtle1/cmd_vel. The target has one publisher and one subscriber; the same 0.5/0.3 Twist reaches turtlesim, pose changes, measured rate is 10.000 Hz. SIGINT plus waiting leaves zero velocity and stable pose.
